`prepHaplotFiles()` no longer shells out to a Perl script (it calls the
bundled `microhaplot-extract` binary directly), so the Perl/`Moo.pm`
environment issue this vignette used to document no longer applies —
there is nothing Perl-related left to troubleshoot. See the "The
microhaplot-extract binary" section of the package README if
`prepHaplotFiles()` fails to find its binary.
